messages:
alex.h: Heads-up: since the egress tightening earlier, new GPU nodes in eu-west-1 aren't fully joining the fleet. Scheduler shows them as "PendingRegistration" and autoscaler keeps retrying.
maria.s: Noted. Any obvious errors in the join logs?
jonathan.k: Paste from node bootstrap logs:
```
2026-02-18T09:12:44Z ERROR attestor: attestation failed: token validation error: caller role boundary check failed
2026-02-18T09:12:44Z INFO keystore: attempting KMS decrypt -> access denied
2026-02-18T09:12:44Z WARN audit-forwarder: connection to audit-sink.redwood-internal blocked (egress 10.0.0.0/8 denylist)
```
casey_r: oof. So three things: role-boundary enforcement, KMS decrypt denied, and audit sink egress blocked. Any recent PRs touching IAM or the egress denylist?
alex.h: Yes — infra #2124 tightened the VPC egress policy to disallow 10.0.0.0/8 ranges to prevent leakage to legacy proxies. Also identity tightened role boundaries last week (2026-02-17).
maria.s: That matches timeline. The node bootstrap needs to reach internal audit-sink over the VPC to complete attestation (we rely on audit token exchange). Denying 10.0.0.0/8 inadvertently blocked the audit-forwarder endpoint IP range.
jonathan.k: And role boundary change means the instance profile's permission to call kms:Decrypt on the ephemeral attestation key got rejected.
casey_r: So nodes hit two fatal errors: cannot decrypt their bootstrap keys and cannot submit attestation logs -> remain PendingRegistration.
sre-oncall: We're seeing autoscaler drain/replace loops, and traffic is spilling to us-west-2 hosted pool. Cost spike alert: +37% cross-region egress and provisioned capacity hours. Billing team pinged.
alex.h: Can we fast-roll a mitigation? Options:
- relax egress rule to allow audit-sink CIDR + add monitoring (fast)
- revert role boundary policy for the instance profile (risky)
- patch bootstrap to use IMDS-signed token fallback (dev effort ~2d)
maria.s: I vote for egress relax + temporary KMS allow on the instance profile. Minimal blast radius if we pin to the specific node role ARNs.
jonathan.k: Agreed. I'll prepare a scoped IAM exception for the node-attestor role to kms:Decrypt on the attestation key ARN and a temporary egress rule to audit-sink CIDR: 10.23.45.0/26.
casey_r: Make sure the egress rule is annotated with a TTL and a Jira for rollback. Ops-bot, can you create the rollback ticket once we deploy?
ops-bot: Created TASK-2987: "egress temporary allow -> audit-sink CIDR; revert after attestation fix" assigned to jonathan.k, due in 48h :white_check_mark:
alex.h: I'm going to throttle the autoscaler to avoid additional cross-region launches while we patch. @sre-oncall can you hold scaleups in eu-west-1? Use the emergency-scaler flag.
sre-oncall: Holding scaleups now. Will also add node draining pause for any in-flight replacements.
jonathan.k: IAM exception PR created: infra#2199. Policy grants kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/attest-key for role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/node-attestor-eu-west1. Added Condition: FromService=ec2.amazonaws.com, SourceVpc=vpce-0abc.
maria.s: Nice. After that I'll patch node bootstrap to detect audit-forwarder unreachable and fallback to proxy-internal (IMDS-signed) and submit attestation over control-plane channel. That'll avoid egress dependency.
casey_r: Deploy plan:
1) Apply egress allow for audit-sink CIDR (10.23.45.0/26) with TTL 2h
2) Merge IAM exception infra#2199
3) Unpause autoscaler and watch node join rates
4) Roll forward bootstrap fallback patch (canary) and monitor
5) Remove egress exception + revoke IAM exception after verification
alex.h: Sounds good. Any tests we should run pre-unpause?
jonathan.k: I'll create a dry-run node in the staging eu-west-1 with the new IAM policy and attempt a full bootstrap. Sharing logs in 10m.
sre-oncall: For visibility — adding billing + security to thread. This caused a ~€14k unexpected bill for the last 6 hours due to cross-region fallback.
maria.s: I'll update the incident doc (inc-2026-02-gpu-provision-bridge) with timeline & cost impact.
alex.h: Thanks. Let's keep chat tight. Post join confirmation and then we'll roll the rollback ticket as done.
jonathan.k: Staging bootstrap succeeded with the scoped IAM exception and egress allowed. Node hits Registered state and passes health checks.
casey_r: Rolling infra#2199 to prod in 2m. Egress allow being applied now.
ops-bot: Deployment infra#2199 succeeded in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 :rocket:
alex.h: Unpausing autoscaler in eu-west-1.
sre-oncall: Autoscaler resumed. New GPU nodes are joining. Observed join rate back to baseline.
maria.s: Monitoring KMS errors and attestation throughput — dropping to normal.
alex.h: Cost hit mitigation: finance approved a one-time credit discussion with cloud provider; ops-sre to follow up.
casey_r: Postmortem TODOs: update bootstrap to IMDS-signed fallback (maria), tighten egress PR review checklist to include audit-forwarder CIDRs (alex), add unit test for role-boundary policy mismatch during bootstrap (jonathan).
alex.h: Great. Closing loop: once the rollback ticket (TASK-2987) is resolved, mark incident doc as resolved and attach cost notes.
sre-oncall: Will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
